title: Beetroot Strider
description: Turns a baby Strider into a beetroot
body:
Turns a baby Strider into a beetroot!
This resource pack changes the texture of a baby Strider (in lava) to that of a beetroot, adding green leaves and replacing the basalt on its legs with dirt.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
Now you can grow your Striders on a farm!
</details>
